from PIL import Image, ImageFilter
import numpy as np
im=Image.open('radiograph.jpg').convert('L')
a=np.asarray(im).astype(np.float32)/255.0
# black-hat: closing - image => dark features
from PIL import ImageFilter as F
img=im
size=25
closed=img.filter(F.MaxFilter(size)).filter(F.MinFilter(size))
c=np.asarray(closed).astype(np.float32)/255.0
bh=c-a  # positive where image darker than local closing
bh=np.clip(bh*4,0,1)
out=Image.fromarray((bh*255).astype('uint8'))
out.resize((1318,646)).save('blackhat.png')
print('ok')
""}
